These coordinates are still a first guess. They were placed by number near the pins that already existed, not by standing on them, so a road may run through a hillside and a park may sit on a motorway. Walk them in game and move them — the names and the hierarchy are the part that matters, and both the JS and the Lua world layer read the same numbers, so fixing one fixes both.

Regenerate this page with node tools/gen-map.js > docs/city-map.html after any change to places.js.
